clue.text: Agitated person who has no place for quiet American?

definitions.text: Agitated person who has no place for quiet American?

parts.words: Agitated person who has no place for quiet American?
parts.note: a jittery person who frets over details can find no room for calm, with a nod to Graham Greene's novel The Quiet American

explanation.surface: Someone flustered refuses to make room for a calm visitor from the States.
explanation.definitionFit: A fussy, agitated person who frets over trifles is the very opposite of a quiet one.

clue.text: Ship caught twice during a fuel change

indicators.note: during puts one piece in the middle of another
change tells us the letters of a fuel are rearranged
twice doubles the letter given for caught

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A vessel is caught twice while refuelling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'change' is the anagram signal and 'during' the insertion; 'twice' doubles the cricket letter for caught before it goes in.
explanation.definitionFit: This narrow sailing boat of the Nile and Mediterranean is a ship.

clue.text: The firm left on time for someone who works with horses

parts.note: stable means firm or steady
AD, anno domini, marks a date in time

explanation.surface: The company left punctually for a groom.
explanation.definitionFit: A boy employed to care for racehorses in a yard works with horses.

clue.text: Being a playwright without love, he wastes away

indicators.note: without tells us to take the letter for love out of the dramatist

parts.note: Arthur Wing Pinero was an English playwright
O is love, a zero score in tennis

explanation.surface: A dramatist without love pines.
explanation.definitionFit: One who pines languishes and wastes away.

clue.text: Passionate speech makes one go into business

indicators.note: go into places the letter for one inside business

parts.note: trade is commerce or business
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A fiery address urges someone into commerce.
explanation.definitionFit: A long angry harangue is a passionate speech.

clue.text: Somewhere to sleep which allows a politician to live in the middle

definitions.text: Somewhere to sleep which allows a politician to live in the middle

parts.words: Somewhere to sleep which allows a politician to live in the middle
parts.note: a portable bed is described as if it housed a Member of Parliament and the verb 'be' at its centre, as the letters of its name do

explanation.surface: A sleeping place lets a politician lodge in the middle of things.
explanation.walkthrough: Spell the answer out and MP (politician) and BE (live) sit in its middle; the clue gives no clear source for the outer letters, so it reads best as a cryptic description.
explanation.definitionFit: A folding bed used by campers or guests is a place to sleep.

clue.text: Sign of religious ban on what may be seen on football grounds

definitions.text: what may be seen on football grounds

parts.note: the cross is a sign of the Christian faith
to bar is to ban

explanation.surface: A religious symbol is barred from football pitches.
explanation.definitionFit: The horizontal beam joining the goalposts stands on every pitch.

clue.text: Errors made when I rush into writing

indicators.note: into places these pieces inside the manuscript

parts.note: MS is manuscript, a piece of writing
to sprint is to rush

explanation.surface: Mistakes occur when I hurry my writing.
explanation.definitionFit: Typographical mistakes in print are errors.

clue.text: Refuse to carry a single man

indicators.note: to carry means the husks hold the letter for one inside

parts.note: bran is the husk left over from milling grain
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Garbage is told to bear one bachelor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Refuse' looks like a verb, but it is the noun: bran is milling waste.
explanation.definitionFit: Brian is a man's name.

clue.text: Takes in when established in lodgings

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation inside the lodgings

parts.note: digs is British slang for rented lodgings

explanation.surface: A lodger absorbs things once settled in rented rooms.
explanation.definitionFit: To absorb food or ideas is to take them in.

clue.text: One who gets paid a pound although only a beginner

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for pound, from Latin libra
an earner is someone who receives pay

explanation.surface: A newly paid worker earning a pound is still only a novice.
explanation.definitionFit: A novice still being taught is a beginner.

clue.text: Getting rid of what may be poisonous in an ancient university?

parts.note: O is the abbreviation for old, so ancient
an insect's sting can carry venom

explanation.surface: Expelling something venomous from an old seat of learning.
explanation.definitionFit: Ejecting or expelling someone is getting rid of them.

clue.text: Place in America where racist trouble arises?

parts.note: colour as in a colour bar, the racial matter, here in American spelling
ado is fuss or trouble
springs means arises or comes up

explanation.surface: An American town where racial strife breaks out.
explanation.walkthrough: COLOR takes the American spelling, fitting the US setting; 'racist' points at colour prejudice.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a city in the US state of Colorado, a place in America.

clue.text: Concedes flowers are headless

indicators.note: a headless word loses its first letter, here the plant name

parts.note: mallows are pink-flowered plants

explanation.surface: A gardener admits the blooms have lost their heads.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flowers' may suggest rivers, but here it is the flowering plants, MALLOWS, which lose their first letter M.
explanation.definitionFit: To concede something is to permit or grant it.

clue.text: One who pursues the opposite sex is more sensible if he leaves Arab territory

definitions.text: One who pursues the opposite sex

indicators.note: the phrase loosely sets the Gulf state among the letters, as if he were dropped amid them

parts.note: wiser means more sensible
Oman is an Arab state on the Arabian peninsula

explanation.surface: A philanderer would be wiser to get out of a Gulf state.
explanation.walkthrough: The insertion signal is loose: 'if he leaves' serves the surface more than the mechanism, but the Gulf state does sit within the comparative.
explanation.definitionFit: A man who chases women persistently is a philanderer.

clue.text: The drug I prohibit is put back into containers

indicators.note: into places the turned piece inside the containers

parts.note: cans are tin containers

indicators.note: put back tells us to turn round the words I and prohibit

parts.note: to ban is to prohibit

explanation.surface: A drug the speaker outlaws is returned to its tins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put back' turns 'I prohibit' round, and 'into' sets that inside the tins; 'The drug' is the definition at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Hemp smoked as marijuana is a well-known drug.

clue.text: Deceiving creatures carrying something to bring in tea on

indicators.note: carrying means the creature holds the server inside

parts.note: a being is a creature; the plural is loose

parts.words: something to bring in tea on
parts.note: a tray carries the tea things

explanation.surface: Animals bearing a tea tray are up to deception.
explanation.definitionFit: Betraying someone is deceiving them.

clue.text: Their occupation is a strain

parts.note: strain seems to mean stress, but it is a line of animals or plants that people raise

explanation.surface: Some workers find their job stressful.
explanation.definitionFit: People who raise livestock or plants develop strains as their trade.

clue.text: It takes time and money to provide evidence of a faulty washer

parts.note: tide is an old word for time or season, as in Yuletide
the mark was German currency

explanation.surface: A slapdash bather leaves a ring that takes time and cash to clean.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'washer' is a person washing, not a tap part: a grimy line left on the neck shows a poor wash.
explanation.definitionFit: A dirty line left on skin or a bath shows someone washed carelessly.

clue.text: Get mine changed since it is suitable for the pregnant

indicators.note: changed tells us the letters of get mine are rearranged

explanation.surface: Fetch my altered garment, since it suits a mother-to-be.
explanation.definitionFit: Pregnant in its sense of full or abounding means swarming.

clue.text: Is a metal a chemical substance?

parts.note: tin is a metallic element

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a metal counts as a chemical.
explanation.definitionFit: This orange compound, used in making dyes, is a chemical substance.

clue.text: Irritated when poverty took precedence

parts.note: need is want or poverty
led means went first, took precedence

explanation.surface: Someone was annoyed when hardship came first.
explanation.definitionFit: Needled means provoked or annoyed.

clue.text: Communist leader employed and given accommodation

parts.note: Ho Chi Minh led communist Vietnam
used means employed

explanation.surface: A Red chief is hired and given a place to stay.
explanation.definitionFit: To be put up somewhere is to be given accommodation.

clue.text: Good relationships might make a dealer that is content

indicators.note: might make suggests these letters can be formed into something new

parts.note: i.e. abbreviates id est, Latin for that is

explanation.surface: A happy trader might foster friendly relations.
explanation.walkthrough: 'might make' rearranges DEALER, IE and CONTENT; the phrase names the 1904 Anglo-French friendship.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means a friendly understanding between nations, good relations.

clue.text: The subject has to choose without the king

indicators.note: without tells us to remove the king's letter

parts.note: to pick is to choose
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: The theme must be chosen without the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: A topic is a subject for discussion.

clue.text: Nocturnal affair which ends with morning

definitions.text: Nocturnal affair which ends with morning

parts.words: Nocturnal affair which ends with morning
parts.note: something that happens in sleep at night and stops on waking; it also literally ends with M, the abbreviation for morning

explanation.surface: A night-time fling that is over by daybreak.
explanation.definitionFit: Visions seen in sleep happen at night and stop when one wakes.

clue.text: Deadlock in trying to give him passengers

indicators.note: to give says the run of words supplies letters from within

explanation.surface: A stalemate arises in trying to hand him travellers.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across the join of 'him passengers'; 'in trying' joins the definition to the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A stalemate in which no progress is possible is a deadlock.

clue.text: In changing places I am peculiar

indicators.note: in changing tells us the letters of places and I are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone moving house declares themselves odd.
explanation.definitionFit: Peculiar in the sense of particular or distinctive matches this.

clue.text: One of these carriages is obtained without a motor

definitions.text: One of these carriages is obtained without a motor

parts.words: One of these carriages is obtained without a motor
parts.note: a child's small wheeled cart is pushed or rolled along, so it runs without an engine, though the name suggests travel

explanation.surface: A carriage that comes with no engine.
explanation.definitionFit: These small wheeled carts, often home-made by children, need no engine.

clue.text: The old woman got on and was injured

parts.note: dam is an old word for mother
to get on is to grow old, so aged

explanation.surface: The elderly lady pressed on and got hurt.
explanation.definitionFit: Something harmed or hurt is injured.
